## My Hobbies

I like listening to music when I study or relax, especially hip-hop music. 
I like it because I can directly feel the emotion of rapper and I can totally 
emerge myself into it. I also make rap songs in my spare time and I released a few songs so far.

### Basketball

I enjoy playing basketball because it helps me strengthen my body and spend time with friends. I was
